posts.author: Skywardd
posts.body: I'm new to RPG Maker 2003 so I have no clue how to go about this but I want to make a puzzle where the player has to move three boxes onto three buttons to open a door. Does anyone know how to do this?

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body:
Yes, boxes have conditionals depending on player facing direction and move that way when interacted with. Then you have a parallel event that puts the box location into variables x1,y1; x2,y2; x3,y3 and if those match the button coordinates (check with nested conditionals) then the door opens.
EDIT: "...then the door opens" -> you can turn ON a switch that changes the door graphic or something
